  WHY: This is documentation precision only, but the Step 0 framing can mislead readers about where the operational trigger lives.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:cleanup-section "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions." sub-bullet (line ~190); Step 0 bullet at line ~12 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

  WHY: An operator cannot distinguish an intentional project-mode skip from a cleanup trigger that never fired.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 190, sub-bullet "If that read fails, archive nothing: treat the label as still present and report `stopped stage sessions kept: label read failed`" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A transient `mcp__github__issue_read` failure is reported only in chat output. The resuming session completes, and if it is later archived by hand, the chat transcript is gone. An operator who notices the orphaned stopped session weeks later cannot determine whether a transient read failure caused it to be skipped.
  WHY: Does not cause a runtime defect -- the fail-closed choice is correct (a session is never archived without proof its question was answered). The report is lost on session archival, which is the normal end state for a completing resume session. A future operator troubleshooting an unarchived `-- blocked on issue` session cannot distinguish "label read failed" from "the label really was still present."
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:cleanup-section "Issue mode: stopped stage sessions." sub-bullet (line ~190); Step 0 bullet at line ~12 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When the plan header lacks a `Source issue:` line, the new Step 0 bullet says the cleanup is skipped silently. The cleanup-section report line "Zombie checkers archived: <n>, plus `stopped stage sessions archived: <m>` in issue mode" only fires when the cleanup actually runs, so a project-mode resume produces no operator-visible log line for the skipped cleanup. An unattended session that fails to enter Step 1 (or fails to invoke the cleanup for any other reason) leaves no signal in the report.
  WHY: After a future regression strips the Step 1 trigger, the operator inspecting the chat output cannot distinguish a project-mode resume that intentionally skipped cleanup from one where the trigger never fired — re-introducing the silent-failure mode the fix was meant to remove.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Step 0 "Issue-mode resume without a `— resume.` block" bullet (line ~12); Step 1 trigger paragraph (line ~16) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Step 0 bullet is a forward reference ("once step 1 has read the plan, run the Zombie-checker cleanup too") rather than a self-contained Step 0 action.
